title: mosfet
description: MOSFET (Si, SiC, GaN, GaAs) component data. The presence of the 'mosfet' field at the top level of an SAS document discriminates the device type — there is no deviceType property.

substitutesInfo.description: Replacement parts for this one: manufacturer-named successors and second sources. An entry with type 'successor' means THIS part is superseded by the named one, one hop, as the manufacturer states it - never inferred from a status of obsolete or from part-number similarity. The schema cannot check that the named part exists in the catalogue, or exists exactly once; that is the referential pass's job, as for CIAS component URIs. Evidence for the claim goes in the record's provenance[] with fields: ["substitutesInfo"], carrying the same sourceUrl, retrievedDate and verification stamp as any datasheet field.

spiceModel.description: Device-body SPICE .model card for a simulation-sourced part (no datasheet). Faithful home that does not require manufacturerInfo.

datasheetInfo.title: mosfetDatasheetInfo
datasheetInfo.description: All information extracted from the MOSFET datasheet.

allOf.$comment: Device-specific narrowing of the shared part def: subType must come from this closed enum (protects the exact-string conditionals, e.g. diode zener/tvs/esd required sets).

dies.description: One entry per die in a multi-die package. Present INSTEAD OF the package-level electrical block, never beside it: a two-die part has no single r_DS(on), V_GS(th) or Q_g, and leaving a package-level slot open is what let one die's numbers be recorded as the part's. Order carries no meaning; die are identified by name.

allOf.$comment: A package that declares two or more die must describe them per die. This is the gate: with no package-level electrical block available, one die's numbers cannot be written as the part's.

die.title: mosfetDie
die.description: One MOSFET die inside a multi-die package, with the complete electrical block the discrete file already defines — the same physics and the same field names as a single-die part, stated once per die. Every die states its own values even when the datasheet prints them as equal ('Q1 = Q2 = 95'), so 'both die are 95 mOhm' and 'the part is 95 mOhm' are different documents.

subType.description: Channel type OF THIS DIE. This is the field a complementary pair needs and the single-die shape cannot provide: the n-channel die says nChannel and the p-channel die says pChannel, in one part. 'powerBlock' is not legal here — it describes a package, not a die.

electrical.description: The complete electrical block, per die. It uses the shared base rather than the package-level 'electrical': continuousDrainCurrent is a package rating that several vendors publish only for the package as a whole, and a die must never be given a package figure to fill that slot.

thermal.description: Per-die thermal figures where the datasheet gives them (junction-to-case, per-die power dissipation). The package-level figure stays in datasheetInfo.thermal — one package, one R_th(j-a).

electricalBase.title: mosfetElectricalBase
electricalBase.description: MOSFET electrical characteristics — every field is relevant to MOSFETs. This base requires the four figures every MOSFET datasheet prints for a single device; the package-level continuousDrainCurrent requirement is added by 'electrical' on top of it. A DIE inside a multi-die package uses this base directly, because a continuous drain current is a package rating and several vendors publish it only per package (TI SLPS666 prints one package operating current and one pulsed I_DM for both die) — requiring it per die would make the faithful record unwritable. Drain-current and dissipation ratings stated at an ambient temperature (board-mounted) live in ambientRatings, never in the case-referred continuousDrainCurrent / powerDissipation.

continuousDrainCurrent.description: I_D at Tc=25C in Amperes. A rating at the solder point (T_sp = 25 C, Nexperia) or the foot / drain lead (T_F = 25 C, Vishay small-signal) is the surface-mount equivalent of the case reference and is stored here too. Case-referred only: a rating the datasheet prints at an AMBIENT temperature (T_A = 25 C, board-mounted) goes in ambientRatings and is never written here.

powerDissipation.description: P_D max at Tc=25C in Watts. A P_D at T_sp or T_F = 25 C counts as case-referred, as for continuousDrainCurrent. Case-referred only: a P_D printed at T_A goes in ambientRatings and is never written here.

ambientRatings.description: Ratings the datasheet states at an AMBIENT temperature with the part mounted on a board - the only drain-current and dissipation ratings most SO-8, SOT-23, TSOP-6, SC-70 and CSP parts print, and the T_A rows printed beside the T_C row on PowerPAK / DFN parts. One entry per printed condition column (time base + mounting), each carrying its rows by ambient temperature. A part may carry both continuousDrainCurrent (T_C) and ambientRatings (T_A); a part printing only T_A ratings carries ambientRatings alone.

onResistanceVgs.description: V_GS for R_DS(on) spec in Volts

onResistanceId.description: I_D for R_DS(on) spec in Amperes

capacitanceMeasurementVds.description: V_DS for cap measurement in Volts

electrical.title: mosfetElectrical
electrical.description: MOSFET electrical characteristics of a single-die part, or of one switch position of a module: the shared base plus a package-level continuous drain current rating, which a whole part always states - either case-referred (continuousDrainCurrent, T_C = 25 C) or, for a part whose datasheet rates it only at an ambient temperature, at least one ambientRatings point carrying continuousDrainCurrent. A part printing a T_C rating is unchanged: the same five required fields.

allOf.$comment: A whole part always rates its continuous drain current. A T_C rating is required exactly as before UNLESS the part carries an ambient point with I_D (a T_A-only part). if/else rather than anyOf so a part with neither still fails with "'continuousDrainCurrent' is a required property". An ambientRatings block holding only P_D or R_th(j-a) does not stand in for a current rating.

ambientRating.title: mosfetAmbientRating
ambientRating.description: One printed ambient-rating condition: a time base (10 s or steady state), the board-mounting note, the junction-to-ambient thermal resistance that applies to it, and the ratings at each ambient temperature printed under it. A Vishay 'ABSOLUTE MAXIMUM RATINGS T_A = 25 C' table with '10 s' and 'Steady State' columns is two entries; a datasheet that prints two mounting conditions (Diodes Inc.: minimum pad vs 1 in^2 copper) is one entry per mounting. An R_th(j-a) row that is printed for a condition with no current or power under it (Vishay 't <= 5 s') is an entry with thermalResistanceJunctionAmbient and no points.

timeBase.description: Which kind of rating the condition is: 'steadyState' (the datasheet's 'Steady State' column or note), or 'transient' (a time-limited rating, 't <= 10 s'; its length is in duration). Absent = the datasheet does not say (a single LIMIT column with no duration note). Never inferred from P_D arithmetic - that inference is a Blade Runner finding, not a datasheet fact.

duration.description: Length of a transient rating, in s ('t <= 10 s' is 10, 't <= 5 s' is 5). Required when timeBase is 'transient'; not allowed otherwise.

mounting.description: The board-mounting condition exactly as the datasheet's note prints it ('Surface mounted on 1" x 1" FR4 board'; 'Device mounted on FR-4 PCB with minimum recommended pad layout, single sided'). Free text because the printed conditions vary along board material, copper area, copper weight, layer count and vias, and no closed vocabulary covers them without inventing equivalences. Absent = the datasheet prints no mounting note.

thermalResistanceJunctionAmbient.description: R_th(j-a) for THIS time base and mounting, in K/W: typical in nominal, maximum in maximum, as printed. The package-level datasheetInfo.thermal.thermalResistanceJunctionAmbient stays a single figure; this one carries the condition the single figure cannot.

points.description: The ratings printed under this condition, one entry per ambient temperature (and per gate drive, where the datasheet rates I_D at more than one V_GS).

allOf.$comment: duration belongs to a transient rating and only to one: a transient rating without its length is not a rating, and a length on a steady-state (or unstated) condition contradicts it.
An entry must carry something: ratings, or the R_th(j-a) of the condition.

ambientRatingPoint.title: mosfetAmbientRatingPoint
ambientRatingPoint.description: The ratings printed at one ambient temperature under one ambientRating condition. Same field names, units and sign convention as the case-referred fields of electricalBase.

ambientTemperature.description: T_A of the row, in degC ('T_A = 70 C' is 70).

gateSourceVoltage.description: Gate drive at which the row is rated, in V, signed as printed - only where the datasheet rates I_D at more than one V_GS (Diodes Inc. 'V_GS = -4.5 V' / '-2.5 V' rows). Absent = one rating, no gate-drive qualifier.

continuousDrainCurrent.description: I_D at this ambient temperature, in A.

powerDissipation.description: P_D at this ambient temperature, in W.

bodyDiodeContinuousCurrent.description: I_S (continuous source current, diode conduction) at this ambient temperature, in A.

is.description: Body diode saturation current in Amperes
